name: VideoVault Premiere Extension
releaseNotes:
- September 7, 2026
- fixes a bug where running Work Local more than once on the same project could quietly corrupt its record of where a clip's server original lives, causing **Use server originals** to later report that file as missing even though it was fine — the extension now trusts the already-known-good server path instead of re-guessing it on every scan
- fixes the same re-guessed path being wrong on Mac in the first place, for anyone hitting this before a second Work Local run
